statement: A code-first JavaScript service is compiled into a genuine WASI component, deployed only through generated lifecycle records to a cluster with data partitions on at least two nodes, invoked through authenticated HTTP, and produces result parity while the harness records per-host local row reads, partial bytes, final bytes, latency distributions, CPU, memory, retries, and topology; no internal native_js service path can satisfy the scenario. Verified at HEAD 761dc17c7: the scenario-harness probe and registry are landed and examples-catalog runs the examples on a live 7-node cluster, but no named public-path multi-node baseline scenario with local-read proof, parity oracle, and resource telemetry exists; this Quest builds that evidence substrate before any runtime change.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn an independent verifier before audit and handoff and record its stable evidence id.
Route the change through the current canonical owners (scenario registry, harness runner, service pipeline); no alternate execution, transport, state, or completion path may satisfy doneWhen.

Evidence must use code-first generated records and genuine WASI Cells; native_js or legacy callback substitution is a failing result, and shard rows must be proven read locally on at least two partition-host nodes with no raw shard-table query delivery across the message router.

The scenario must fail if the public WASM path is replaced by native_js, if both partitions land on one host, if metrics are synthetic, or if result parity is inferred from the service under test instead of an independent oracle.

The emitted report schema (digests, topology, local-read proof, p50/p95/p99, bytes by channel, CPU, peak memory, retries, fidelity 'live') must be stable enough for public-path-scale-and-failure-certification to consume unchanged.
